title: XGET: msgid_map.lookup_by_cid is not the inverse of msgid_map.insert
description: In xget.rs, handle_xget() calls msgid_map.lookup_by_cid(&cid) as a group-membership check to ensure only known article CIDs can be fetched. However, the article pipeline stores root CIDs (codec 0x71 DAG-CBOR) in the msgid_map via write_ipld_article_to_ipfs. The XGET command takes an arbitrary CID string from the client. If the client passes a child block CID (the header or body sub-block, codec 0x55 raw) rather than the root CID, lookup_by_cid will return None (403) because only root CIDs are in the msgid_map. This is correct security behavior. But the converse: if an operator stores the root CID in msgid_map and the client passes the root CID, get_raw() is called on the root block which returns DAG-CBOR bytes, not the article wire format. The client can then abuse XGET to extract DAG-CBOR root metadata. This is documented as intended behavior in the ADR-0007 description, but the security comment 'prevents fetching arbitrary blocks' only applies to unknown CIDs — known article root CIDs are fully exposed in DAG-CBOR form.
